items.title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600%, outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets
items.summary: A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price.

items.title: Solana leads bitcoin and ether higher while Korean chip stocks slide 7%
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,000 and every major except BNB gained, while Korean semiconductor stocks fell more than 7% and Fed minutes are due at 2 p.m. ET.

items.title: ‘It has to pass’: Andrew Cuomo warns U.S. is falling behind on crypto rules
items.summary: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo says the CLARITY Act is key to linking crypto and traditional markets.

items.title: Robinhood CEO urges U.S. to clear path for tokenized stocks as overseas markets advance
items.summary: Vlad Tenev says tokenized stocks could bring real-time settlement and 24/7 trading, but U.S. rules remain a hurdle.

items.title: U.S. accounting-standards group proposes way to see stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'
items.summary: The Financial Accounting Standards Board, a nonprofit that governs accounting practices, proposed that certain stablecoins should fit the bill as cash-like.
